The Read

A full audit of how your company finds, wins and keeps customers, across strategy, growth, distribution and revenue, and the tools underneath. For founders and teams working through a fast-changing mix of marketing, commercial and growth strategy, in new categories and established ones.

Who it's for

When the problem is real, but the next move isn't clear.

You don't need to know which part is broken. That's what the Read is for.

You raised, and the story isn't landing.You spent on an agency and have nothing to point at.The product is strong, but nobody explains it the same way twice.There's a launch coming and nobody owns the plan.The community went quiet, and nobody knows if that's marketing or product.You're about to pay KOLs or affiliates before you know what they should drive.Your ads stopped when the person running them left.The playbook that used to work has stopped working.Buyers ask an AI about your category, and it names your competitor.You're running more channels and tools than anyone can keep track of.

Not the right fit if

  • You already know the fix and need someone to run it. Start with a Build instead.
  • You want a free proposal. The diagnosis is the work.
  • You need answers this week. The Read takes two to three.

What we need from you

Access
Read-only access to analytics, ad accounts, CRM, email and your store or billing
People
Three to five conversations with the people who sell and decide
Material
Decks, pricing, past campaigns and what you've already tried
One owner
One person who can answer questions within a day or two

How it runs

Two to three weeks. Start to answer.

The clock starts when payment and access are both in. If something's missing, we say so that day.

Week0

Kickoff

Agree the scope and the one question that matters most. Set up access.

Week1

What you have

Your numbers, accounts, decks and campaigns. Interviews with the people who sell and decide.

Week2

The market

Competitors, buyers, channels and AI answers, checked against our research. A midpoint check-in.

Week3

The Read

The written report and priced plan, then a 60 to 90 minute walk-through.

What you get

Defined problem. Defined output.

The written Read. About 30 pages in five parts. Every page opens with its finding.The 90-day plan. Three priorities, each with an owner, a cost and a metric.The budget view. Where the money should go, and what cutting frees up.The fix list. The changes that make your numbers agree.The walk-through. A 60 to 90 minute call to go through it together.The sources. Every number traceable to where it came from.

Not included: running ads, building pages, producing content or managing vendors. Ad spend and tools stay yours.

Price

$2,500

Flat. Agreed before we start, and it doesn't change.

How we handle money

  • Fees are flat and agreed before the work starts.
  • We never take a percentage of money raised or media spent.
  • No paid placement in our research, directory or calendar.
  • If we recommend a partner we have a relationship with, we say so.
  • Half at scope, the rest within 15 days of the report.

Questions

Before you book.

Why isn't it free?

Because the diagnosis is the work. A free version would be a sales pitch, and you'd be right to read it that way.

Can it look at just one area?

Yes. Tell us on the first call. If the problem is narrow, we'll say so and keep the Read focused on it.

Who does the work?

Chris Wells leads every Read, with a small team of specialists where a part needs one. The people who write the report are the people you talk to.

What if the problem isn't marketing?

We'll say so. Sometimes it's the product, the price or the team, and the Read is more useful if it tells you that.

Do you do the work afterwards?

If you want us to. Plenty of teams run the plan themselves, and that's fine.

Bring us the commercial problem.

You do not need to know which service you need. Tell us where the business is getting stuck.
